metadata.name: Treasure Offering
metadata.description:
The treasure room accepts offerings... but only after the floor's guardian falls.
Leave a trinket on the floor of the treasure room. Once the floor's boss is dead, come back: your offering becomes a Cracked Key.
- One offering per floor. Leave more than one and only the first is taken. - Order doesn't matter: offer before or after the boss, it happens when you walk back in. - XL floors: both bosses must fall.
Mod Config Menu (optional): Treasure Offering ON/OFF.
